units.name: Attenuated Drift
units.descrip: Thin and discontinuous deposits of sandy loamy till, separated by numerous or extensive bedrock outcrops, on which are scattered erratics.  Includes unmapped grus and felsenmeer in the north-central New Brunswick Highlands.  Till thickness generally 0.5-2 m; grus and felsenmeer thicknesses 2 m to more than 5 m.

units.name: td
units.descrip: Areas of many bedrock outcrops and/or thin surficial deposits (generally less than 3 m thick). The type of surficial material is known or inferred. Topography of these areas refelcts the configuration of the bedrock surface, and ranges from smooth undulating hills to knobby terrain and high mountains. Commonly the result of non-deposition of glacial sediments, but the surficial materials in some coastal areas have been largely removed by marine erosion in late-glacial time
